principles: Unreleased SoCs receive probabilistic priors, never fixed winner labels.
Priors must distinguish peak performance, sustained performance, power efficiency, thermals, modem/RF and workload class.
Current-generation evidence can shift priors for successors, but uncertainty must remain wider than for released silicon.
Architecture/process rumors are supporting evidence only until silicon measurements exist.

rationale: Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 shows repeated thermal/stability problems in conventional passive-cooling flagships.
Exynos 2600 already demonstrated strong synthetic sustained stability in some workloads despite weaker real-game thermals.
Rumors claim Exynos 2700 uses Samsung SF2P with materially lower power than Exynos 2600, but this is unverified.
Early Exynos 2700 engineering-sample benchmarks are too immature for final performance ranking.
